description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayConnection component, specifically focusing on websocket connection status and message rejection scenarios. It includes mock implementations of WebSocket tasks and sessions to simulate network interactions.

classes.description: A test suite that checks the gateway connection's behavior when process is missing and message validation.
